narrative: Today names the MCP-server and tool-execution boundary as the concentrating point of exploitable code: the Flowise custom-MCP RCE (CVSS 9.9) slips past a validateCommandFlags blocklist via a regex bypass, and AutoGen Studio runs agent-generated code in the host process with excessive privileges. That is the incident pressure motivating inline default policy enforcement on exactly the channel this prediction expects to gain it.
remaining_gap: No platform has yet shipped inline allowlist-based MCP policy as a productized default, so today is motivating evidence rather than the shipped control.
